parent_objective: implement a no-rollout controlled comparison panel preflight from M2022 design
blocked_by: M2022 admits only no-rollout panel preflight before any routing smoke or ranking

public_gates: M2023 must not reset the environment or execute policy actions
M2023 must read profile metadata and candidate source artifacts
M2023 must write panel protocol workload source coverage and claim-boundary artifacts
M2023 must fail closed on missing profile coverage source coverage or actor-contract checks
M2023 must keep ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: materializes the M2022 design into no-rollout protocol artifacts and coverage checks
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: no-rollout panel preflight only; no driver performance mechanism ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if profile coverage is incomplete
stop if source coverage is too narrow or source-kind singleton dominated
stop if claim-boundary artifact is missing
stop if any environment reset or policy action is executed
fallback_plan: route to profile inventory repair if controller profiles are incomplete
route to source/task repair if source coverage is incomplete
route to design repair if claim gates cannot be represented in artifacts

admission_evidence: M2022 defines controller matrix task families source/holdout rules and claim gates
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window-vs-GRU or paper-level evidence
allowed_updates: M2023 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for preflight result audit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2023 is no-rollout preflight; it prepares current-frame finite-window and recurrent controls but does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: Represent same-current different-older-history family in the panel protocol if source support exists.
Represent wrong/delayed/mismatched history gates only as future claim gates, not as M2023 results.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: No execution in M2023; protocol metadata only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If preflight coverage is insufficient, route to repair instead of ranking or self-ID testing.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: creates a preflight artifact layer for a new controlled-comparison evidence type
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can determine whether the controlled panel is ready for routing smoke or must repair profile/source coverage first
must_synthesize_if: M2023 cannot produce clean preflight artifacts
M2023 reveals source-kind singleton dominance across the intended panel
M2023 proposes direct full execution after failed preflight

hypothesis: A no-rollout preflight can materialize the M2022 controlled comparison panel into protocol artifacts with clean guardrails.
success_criteria: panel protocol workload matrix source coverage and claim-boundary artifacts exist
no rerun ranking finite-window-vs-GRU paper-level or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: source coverage is incomplete or overclaimed
environment rollout or policy action execution occurs
ranking or finite-window-vs-GRU claims are made

commands.name: implement_and_run
commands.command: implement focused no-rollout controlled comparison panel preflight and run it on existing profile/source artifacts

decision_rule: M2023 passes if it writes clean no-rollout preflight artifacts and keeps claim boundaries blocked.
